label: Countdown
when: a live timer counting down to a date and time the member gave (an opening, a sale's end, an event)
rules: Only when the request gives the end date and time; never invent them. "endDateTime" is that moment in UTC, like 2027-09-04T09:00:00.000Z (convert the member's local time; if no time zone is known, take it as UTC). Each unit block (day, hour, minute, second) holds a number block, no attributes, and a label block whose "text" is the unit's plural name; separator blocks go between units. To drop a unit, set "showDays", "showHours", "showMinutes" or "showSeconds" to false and omit its block and a separator. Not in English: also set "dayLabel", "daysLabel" (same for hour, minute, second).
example:
<!-- wp:spectra/countdown {"endDateTime":"2027-09-04T09:00:00.000Z","showSeconds":false} -->
<!-- wp:spectra/countdown-child-day -->
<!-- wp:spectra/countdown-child-number /-->

<!-- wp:spectra/countdown-child-label {"text":"Days"} /-->
<!-- /wp:spectra/countdown-child-day -->

<!-- wp:spectra/countdown-child-separator /-->

<!-- wp:spectra/countdown-child-hour -->
<!-- wp:spectra/countdown-child-number /-->

<!-- wp:spectra/countdown-child-label {"text":"Hours"} /-->
<!-- /wp:spectra/countdown-child-hour -->

<!-- wp:spectra/countdown-child-separator /-->

<!-- wp:spectra/countdown-child-minute -->
<!-- wp:spectra/countdown-child-number /-->

<!-- wp:spectra/countdown-child-label {"text":"Minutes"} /-->
<!-- /wp:spectra/countdown-child-minute -->
